name: AIPromptInput
summary: AI prompt composer. Auto-grows multiline textarea + leading model selector + trailing send button (the lone primary on the surface) + optional attachment + slash-command picker + token counter. Distinct from a plain Textarea — it carries the AI-shimmer treatment, sparkles-leading send icon, and a contract that the consumer wires to streaming responses.

modelSelector.description: Optional Select / DropdownMenu rendered at the leading edge. Use to switch models or modes.

attachments.description: Render-prop slot for attachment chips above the textarea.

slashCommands.description: When the user types '/', this slot opens a Combobox of commands.

tokenCount.description: Renders 'N / M tokens' below the input. Style with type.eyebrow.mono.

loading.description: Mid-streaming. Disables submit, swaps send icon for stop.

keyboard: Tab - move between input, attach, send
Enter - newline by default; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter submits
/ - open slash commands when typed at start
rules: <textarea> with aria-label='Prompt'; visible model selector inherits aria-label='AI model'.
Loading: the streaming response uses aria-live='polite' on the OUTPUT region, not on the input.
Stop button (during streaming) has aria-label='Stop generating'.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: drop the AI-shimmer on the send button; render it as a solid action.ai surface.

do: Lead with the model selector OR a sparkles glyph — the user must see 'this is AI' at a glance.
Submit shortcut: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter. Plain Enter inserts a newline.
Stop button replaces Send while streaming.
Render token counter when nearing the limit (>= 75%).
Use intent='ai' on the send button (lime-tinted, with AI shimmer).
dont: Don't render the AI shimmer when disabled or loading.
Don't auto-submit on plain Enter — accidental sends destroy trust.
Don't render the AI input on operator surfaces without an explicit indicator that this is AI-generated content.
